root_cause: Existing GitHub job timing collector accepted any non-null completed job conclusion, including skipped provider placeholders with identical started/completed timestamps. Skipped zero-duration records can distort p50/p95 and hide execution bottlenecks.

observed_evidence.first_provider_observation: SAMPLED_METRICS_NOT_SLO / 25 jobs from 12 runs / provider wait p50 3000ms and p95 4000ms, not a long-term SLO
observed_evidence.tool_data_kind: GitHub Actions REST job created_at/started_at/completed_at timestamps; must use raw endpoint to obtain timing fields; shortened job wrapper may omit these fields

failed_approaches: Count any completed job as actual runner execution, including skipped zero-duration placeholders
Treat a single job maximum as the workflow critical path or optimization result
Publish diagnostics when provider job enumeration was partial
fix: Only completed success/failure/timed_out job records with valid timestamps and run+attempt+job identity enter the sample. Skipped, neutral and cancelled conclusions are excluded. Once original >=20 valid jobs and >=5 independent runs rule passes, include a bounded, attribution-tagged top-five execution-time diagnostic ordered deterministically. If an API read is incomplete, return no valid hotspots.
prevention_rule: Never include provider placeholders, missing timestamps, missing identities, duplicates, incomplete provider reads, or non-executed jobs in execution-time percentiles/hotspot claims. Hotspot max is investigation evidence only, not a causal critical path, validated speed gain, released change or release-approval. Preserve Required, CodeQL, tenant/RLS, financial, visual and provider checks; reuse the same hourly Janitor, not a new scheduler or action dispatcher.

invariants: skipped completed zero-ms records cannot enter sample
≥20 executed jobs and ≥5 distinct workflow runs remain required
incomplete GitHub run/job data yields no diagnostic hotspots
observed top five job execution times are diagnostic, never optimization claim
same single hourly Janitor scheduler and protected merge/security gates

terminal_rule: Only mark deployed after exact-head Required/CodeQL, protected GitHub merge, exact-main readback and real subsequent Janitor artifact with executed-only telemetry and skill projection; #4661 remains open for longitudinal throughput.
